Create one portrait canvas with aspect ratio exactly 2:3, preferably 1024 by 1536 pixels. Divide the ENTIRE canvas into an EXACT 2 by 2 grid of four equal rectangular images. Top-right: original adult forest letter messenger carrying a weathered canvas mail satchel, holding a sealed unmarked envelope, luminous green forest background, natural human expression.
Bottom-left: original adult astronomer in a winter coat beside a snowy mountaintop observatory, pale cobalt dusk and soft warm light from its doorway, portrait composition.
Bottom-right: original adult person carrying a bright yellow umbrella in a breezy spring meadow, soft green grass, luminous overcast sky, gently moving hair, portrait composition.
Style: expressive original anime illustration with believable anatomy, confident clean linework, painted atmospheric backgrounds, subtle cinematic lighting, rich but natural color. These are quiet specific moments, not promotional posters. Each image must feel distinct and personally collectible.
Constraints: completely original people and settings; no existing franchise characters, no artist imitation, no brands, no signatures, no readable text, no labels, no lettering, no watermarks, no captions, no UI, no decorative framing. Avoid duplicated poses/compositions. Full-bleed art in all four cells; exact equal 2x2 layout is critical for CSS sprite cropping.
